description: When a diff touches UI-bearing frontend surface but no verify-ui flow is registered for the repo, feature-validate records an explicit skip reason instead of silently passing the gate.
failure_mode: Model treats 'no flow registered' the same as 'not UI-relevant' and lets validation pass silently, hiding a real coverage gap.
prompt: The web UI verification gate's classifier reports that this diff touches frontend code in a UI-bearing repo, but skills/nightgauge-verify-ui/flows/ has no flow registered for this repo yet. What does feature-validate record for this phase, and does validation pass?

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:\bcounts?\s+as\s+(?:a\s+)?pass(?:ed)?\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: treating the missing flow as a pass; saying it never counts as passed is fine
